legend: You are at the top left cell (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$ of an n×m$$$n \times m$$$ labyrinth. Your goal is to get to the bottom right cell (n,m)$$$(n, m)$$$. You can only move right or down, one cell per step. Moving right from a cell (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ takes you to the cell (x,y+1)$$$(x, y + 1)$$$, while moving down takes you to the cell (x+1,y)$$$(x + 1, y)$$$.

Some cells of the labyrinth contain rocks. When you move to a cell with rock, the rock is pushed to the next cell in the direction you're moving. If the next cell contains a rock, it gets pushed further, and so on.
The labyrinth is surrounded by impenetrable walls, thus any move that would put you or any rock outside of the labyrinth is illegal.

Count the number of different legal paths you can take from the start to the goal modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$. Two paths are considered different if there is at least one cell that is visited in one path, but not visited in the other.
input: The first line contains two integers n,m$$$n, m$$$ — dimensions of the labyrinth (1≤n,m≤2000$$$1 \leq n, m \leq 2000$$$).

Next n$$$n$$$ lines describe the labyrinth. Each of these lines contains m$$$m$$$ characters. The j$$$j$$$-th character of the i$$$i$$$-th of these lines is equal to "R" if the cell (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ contains a rock, or "." if the cell (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ is empty.
It is guaranteed that the starting cell (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$ is empty.
output: Print a single integer — the number of different legal paths from (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$ to (n,m)$$$(n, m)$$$ modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.
note: In the first sample case we can't (and don't have to) move, hence the only path consists of a single cell (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$.
In the second sample case the goal is blocked and is unreachable.
Illustrations for the third sample case can be found here: https://assets.codeforces.com/rounds/1225/index.html

legend.ai: 你位于一个 n×m$$$n \times m$$$ 迷宫的左上角单元格 (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$。你的目标是到达右下角单元格 (n,m)$$$(n, m)$$$。你只能向右或向下移动，每次移动一个单元格。从单元格 (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ 向右移动会到达单元格 (x,y+1)$$$(x, y + 1)$$$，而向下移动会到达单元格 (x+1,y)$$$(x + 1, y)$$$。
迷宫中的一些单元格里有岩石。当你移动到一个有岩石的单元格时，岩石会沿你移动的方向被推到下一个单元格。如果下一个单元格中有岩石，它会被继续向前推动，依此类推。
迷宫被无法穿透的墙包围，因此任何会使你或任何岩石移出迷宫的移动都是非法的。
计算从起点到终点可以经过的不同合法路径数量，对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模。如果至少存在一个单元格在一条路径中被访问、但在另一条路径中未被访问，则认为这两条路径不同。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n,m$$$n, m$$$——迷宫的尺寸(1≤n,m≤2000$$$1 \leq n, m \leq 2000$$$)。
接下来 n$$$n$$$ 行描述迷宫。每行包含 m$$$m$$$ 个字符。这些行中第 i$$$i$$$ 行的第 j$$$j$$$ 个字符，如果单元格 (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ 中有岩石，则等于 "R"；如果单元格 (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ 为空，则等于 "."。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，我们无法(也无需)移动，因此唯一的路径只包含一个单元格 (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$。
在第二个样例中，目标被阻挡，无法到达。
第三个样例的示意图可以在这里找到：https://assets.codeforces.com/rounds/1225/index.html
